package auth

import (
	"net/http"

	identityapplication "github.com/domainry/domainry-identity/internal/application/identity"
	identitycontract "github.com/domainry/domainry-identity/internal/domain/identity/contract"
	identitymodel "github.com/domainry/domainry-identity/internal/domain/identity/model"
)

type routeRegistrar interface {
	HandleFunc(string, func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request))
}

func (h *AuthHandler) RegisterRoutes(mux routeRegistrar) {
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.discovery.jwks", h.authJSONWebKeySet)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.discovery.openid_configuration", h.authOpenIDConfiguration)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.login", h.authLogin)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.guest", h.authGuest)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.refresh", h.authRefresh)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.logout", h.authLogout)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.sessions.revoke_others", h.authRevokeOtherSessions)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.change_password", h.authChangePassword)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, identitycontract.IdentityActionAuthResetPassword, h.authResetPassword)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.list", h.authProviders)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.setup_check", h.authProviderSetupCheck)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, identitycontract.IdentityActionAuthProvidersSetup, h.authProviderSetupSave)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.start_get", h.authProviderStart)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.start_post", h.authProviderStart)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.callback_get", h.authProviderCallback)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.callback_post", h.authProviderCallback)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.verify", h.authProviderVerify)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.providers.exchange", h.authProviderExchange)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.external_accounts.list", h.authExternalAccounts)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.external_accounts.bind", h.authBindExternalAccount)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.external_accounts.unbind", h.authUnbindExternalAccount)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.me.get", h.authMe)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.me.update", h.authUpdateCurrentUserLocale)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.role_options.list", h.authRoleOptions)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.role_requests.list", h.authRoleRequests)
	h.registerAuthAction(mux, "auth.role_requests.create", h.authCreateRoleRequest)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) registerAuthAction(mux routeRegistrar, actionKey string, next http.HandlerFunc) {
	action, found := h.actionAuthorization.Definition(actionKey)
	if !found || action.HTTP == nil {
		panic("Auth route references unregistered action " + actionKey)
	}
	mux.HandleFunc(action.HTTP.Method+" "+action.HTTP.RouteTemplate, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		principal := identitymodel.Principal{}
		if h.principal != nil {
			principal = h.principal(r)
		}
		if !h.actionAuthorization.Allows(action, principal, identityapplication.IdentityActionAuthorizationContext{}) {
			if h.securityAudit != nil {
				h.securityAudit(r, "auth_api_denied", "Auth API action denied", map[string]any{
					"action_key": action.Key, "path": r.URL.Path, "method": r.Method, "strategy": action.Authorization.Strategy,
				})
			}
			if h.writeError != nil {
				if !principal.Known {
					h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusUnauthorized, "auth.token_required")
					return
				}
				h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusForbidden, "auth.permission_denied")
				return
			}
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		next(w, r)
	})
}

		ExpiresAt:  req.ExpiresAt,

}

func ProjectParticipantWorkflowProcess(process workflowmodel.WorkflowProcessInstance) ParticipantWorkflowProcessDTO {
	return ParticipantWorkflowProcessDTO{
		ID: process.ID, WorkflowKey: process.WorkflowKey, WorkflowName: process.WorkflowName,
		ObjectKey: process.ObjectKey, RecordID: process.RecordID, InitiatorID: process.InitiatorID,
		Status: process.Status, CurrentNodeNames: process.CurrentNodeNames, BusinessOutcome: process.BusinessOutcome,
		CreatedAt: process.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: process.UpdatedAt, CompletedAt: process.CompletedAt,
	}
}

func ProjectParticipantWorkflowRun(result workflowmodel.WorkflowRunResult) ParticipantWorkflowRunDTO {
	return ParticipantWorkflowRunDTO{
		WorkflowKey: result.WorkflowKey, Name: result.Name, Status: result.Status, ProcessID: result.Execution.ProcessID,
	}
}

func projectParticipantWorkflowTask(task workflowmodel.WorkflowTask) ParticipantWorkflowTaskDTO {
	return ParticipantWorkflowTaskDTO{
		ID: task.ID, ProcessID: task.ProcessID, NodeInstanceID: task.NodeInstanceID, NodeID: task.NodeID,
		Title: task.Title, AssigneeUserID: task.AssigneeUserID, AssigneeName: task.AssigneeName,
		AssigneeRoleKey: task.AssigneeRoleKey, Sequence: task.Sequence, Status: task.Status,
		Decision: task.Decision, Comment: task.Comment, DueAt: task.DueAt,
		CompletedBy: task.CompletedBy, CompletedAt: task.CompletedAt,
		CreatedAt: task.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: task.UpdatedAt,
	}
}

func ProjectParticipantWorkflowProcessDetail(detail WorkflowProcessDetail) ParticipantWorkflowProcessDetailDTO {
	projected := ParticipantWorkflowProcessDetailDTO{
		Process: ProjectParticipantWorkflowProcess(detail.Process),
		Nodes:   make([]ParticipantWorkflowNodeDTO, 0, len(detail.Nodes)),
		Tasks:   make([]ParticipantWorkflowTaskDTO, 0, len(detail.Tasks)),
		Events:  make([]ParticipantWorkflowEventDTO, 0, len(detail.Events)),
	}
	for _, node := range detail.Nodes {
		name, actionKey := node.NodeID, ""
		if detail.Process.DefinitionSnapshot.Graph != nil {
			for _, definitionNode := range detail.Process.DefinitionSnapshot.Graph.Nodes {
				if definitionNode.ID != node.NodeID {
					continue
				}
				if strings.TrimSpace(definitionNode.Name) != "" {
					name = definitionNode.Name
				}
				if definitionNode.Contract != nil && definitionNode.Contract.Action != nil {
					actionKey = definitionNode.Contract.Action.ActionKey
				}
				if actionKey == "" && definitionNode.Config != nil {
					actionKey, _ = definitionNode.Config["action_key"].(string)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		projected.Nodes = append(projected.Nodes, ParticipantWorkflowNodeDTO{
			ID: node.ID, NodeID: node.NodeID, Name: name, NodeType: node.NodeType, ActionKey: actionKey, Iteration: node.Iteration,
			Status: node.Status, ErrorCode: node.ErrorCode, StartedAt: node.StartedAt, CompletedAt: node.CompletedAt,
		})
	}
	for _, task := range detail.Tasks {
		projected.Tasks = append(projected.Tasks, projectParticipantWorkflowTask(task))
	}
	for _, event := range detail.Events {
		projected.Events = append(projected.Events, ParticipantWorkflowEventDTO{
			ID: event.ID, NodeID: event.NodeID, TaskID: event.TaskID, Event: event.Event,
			ActorID: event.ActorID, Summary: event.Summary, CreatedAt: event.CreatedAt,
		})

const conversionThreshold = "100000.00"

type leadExecution interface {
	Principal() capabilities.Principal
	TargetID() schema.SalesLeadID
}

type salesLeadUpdater interface {
	GetForUpdate(context.Context, schema.SalesLeadID) (schema.SalesLead, error)
	ConditionalUpdate(context.Context, data.SalesLeadUpdateMutation) (schema.SalesLead, error)
}

type leadAuditCreator interface {
	Create(context.Context, schema.CreateLeadAudit) (schema.LeadAudit, error)
}

func amountCompare(amount schema.SalesLeadEstimatedAmount, threshold string) (int, error) {
	value, ok := new(big.Rat).SetString(string(amount))
	if !ok {
		return 0, &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.amount_invalid"}
	}
	limit, ok := new(big.Rat).SetString(threshold)
	if !ok {
		return 0, &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.threshold_invalid"}
	}
	return value.Cmp(limit), nil
}

func createLeadAudit(ctx context.Context, audits leadAuditCreator, leadID schema.SalesLeadID, actorID string, event, from, to string, reason *string, occurredAt time.Time) error {
	var fromValue *schema.LeadAuditFromStatus
	if from != "" {
		value := schema.LeadAuditFromStatus(from)
		fromValue = &value
	}
	var toValue *schema.LeadAuditToStatus
	if to != "" {
		value := schema.LeadAuditToStatus(to)
		toValue = &value
	}
	created, err := audits.Create(ctx, schema.CreateLeadAudit{
		ActorID:    schema.NewLeadAuditActorIDReference(schema.IdentityUserID(actorID)),
		EventType:  schema.LeadAuditEventType(event),
		FromStatus: fromValue,
		LeadID:     schema.NewLeadAuditLeadIDReference(leadID),
		OccurredAt: occurredAt,
		Reason:     reason,
		ToStatus:   toValue,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if created.ID == "" {
		return &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.audit_result_invalid"}
	}
	return nil
}

func transitionLead(ctx context.Context, execution leadExecution, leads salesLeadUpdater, audits leadAuditCreator, from, to, event string, reason *string) error {
	lead, err := leads.GetForUpdate(ctx, execution.TargetID())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if lead.Status != schema.SalesLeadStatus(from) {
		return &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.transition_invalid"}
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	mutation := data.NewSalesLeadUpdate(lead.ID).
		SetStatus(schema.SalesLeadStatus(to)).
		SetStatusChangedAt(now).
		RequireStatusEqual(lead.Status, "sales_lead.transition_conflict").
		WithExpectedUpdatedAt(lead.UpdatedAt)
	updated, err := leads.ConditionalUpdate(ctx, mutation)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if updated.ID == "" {
		return &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.transition_result_invalid"}
	}
	return createLeadAudit(ctx, audits, lead.ID, execution.Principal().UserID, event, from, to, reason, now)

func ApproveConversion(ctx context.Context, caps capabilities.ApproveConversionCapabilities, input capabilities.ApproveConversionInput) (capabilities.ApproveConversionOutput, error) {
	_ = input
	lead, err := caps.SalesLead.GetForUpdate(ctx, caps.Execution.TargetID())
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.ApproveConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	exists, err := caps.Customer.Exists(ctx, data.NewCustomerQuery().WhereSourceLeadIDEqual(schema.NewCustomerSourceLeadIDReference(lead.ID)))
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.ApproveConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	if lead.Status == schema.SalesLeadStatus("converted") && exists {
		return capabilities.ApproveConversionOutput{}, nil
	}
	comparison, err := amountCompare(lead.EstimatedAmount, conversionThreshold)
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.ApproveConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	if lead.Status != schema.SalesLeadStatus("qualified") || comparison < 0 || exists {
		return capabilities.ApproveConversionOutput{}, &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.approval_invalid"}
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	updated, err := caps.SalesLead.ConditionalUpdate(ctx, data.NewSalesLeadUpdate(lead.ID).
		SetStatus(schema.SalesLeadStatus("converted")).
		SetStatusChangedAt(now).
		ClearRejectionReason().
		RequireStatusEqual(lead.Status, "sales_lead.conversion_conflict").
		WithExpectedUpdatedAt(lead.UpdatedAt))
	if err != nil {

// RejectConversion implements the project-owned sales_lead.reject_conversion Handler.
func RejectConversion(ctx context.Context, caps capabilities.RejectConversionCapabilities, input capabilities.RejectConversionInput) (capabilities.RejectConversionOutput, error) {
	if input.RejectionReason == "" {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.rejection_reason_required"}
	}
	lead, err := caps.SalesLead.GetForUpdate(ctx, caps.Execution.TargetID())
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	exists, err := caps.Customer.Exists(ctx, data.NewCustomerQuery().WhereSourceLeadIDEqual(schema.NewCustomerSourceLeadIDReference(lead.ID)))
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	if lead.RejectionReason != nil && *lead.RejectionReason == input.RejectionReason && !exists {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, nil
	}
	comparison, err := amountCompare(lead.EstimatedAmount, conversionThreshold)
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	if lead.Status != schema.SalesLeadStatus("qualified") || comparison < 0 || exists {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.rejection_invalid"}
	}
	mutation := data.NewSalesLeadUpdate(lead.ID).
		SetRejectionReason(input.RejectionReason).
		RequireStatusEqual(lead.Status, "sales_lead.rejection_conflict").
		WithExpectedUpdatedAt(lead.UpdatedAt)
	if lead.RejectionReason == nil {
		mutation = mutation.RequireRejectionReasonNull("sales_lead.rejection_conflict")
	} else {
		mutation = mutation.RequireRejectionReasonEqual(*lead.RejectionReason, "sales_lead.rejection_conflict")
	}
	updated, err := caps.SalesLead.ConditionalUpdate(ctx, mutation)
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	reason := input.RejectionReason
	if err = createLeadAudit(ctx, caps.LeadAudit, lead.ID, caps.Execution.Principal().UserID, "conversion_rejected", "qualified", "qualified", &reason, now); err != nil {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	companyName := lead.CompanyName
	notificationID, err := caps.Notifications.Dispatch(ctx, capabilities.RejectConversionNotificationIntent{
		EventType:        "lead.conversion_rejected",
		SourceEventID:    "lead-conversion-rejected:" + string(lead.ID),
		RecipientUserIDs: []string{string(lead.ResponsibleUserID.ID())},
		SubjectObjectKey: "sales_lead",
		SubjectRecordID:  string(lead.ID),
		SubjectVersion:   updated.UpdatedAt,
		DedupeKey:        "lead-conversion-rejected:" + string(lead.ID),
		GroupKey:         "lead-conversion:" + string(lead.ID),
		Alert:            true,
		OccurredAt:       now,
		Variables: []capabilities.RejectConversionNotificationVariable{
			{Key: "company_name", StringValue: &companyName},
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, err
	}
	if notificationID == "" {
		return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, &capabilities.BusinessError{Code: "sales_lead.notification_result_invalid"}
	}
	return capabilities.RejectConversionOutput{}, nil
}

func SendOverdueReminders(ctx context.Context, caps capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersCapabilities, input capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersInput) (capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput, error) {
	_ = input
	now := time.Now()
	location, err := time.LoadLocation("Asia/Shanghai")
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput{}, err
	}
	localNow := now.In(location)
	cutoff := localNow.AddDate(0, 0, -7)
	businessDate := time.Date(localNow.Year(), localNow.Month(), localNow.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, location)
	leads, err := caps.SalesLead.List(ctx, data.NewSalesLeadQuery().
		WhereStatusEqual(schema.SalesLeadStatus("contacted")).
		OrderByIDAscending().
		Page(1, 200))
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput{}, err
	}
	eligible := make([]schema.SalesLead, 0, len(leads))
	queries := make([]data.FollowupReminderReceiptQuery, 0, len(leads))
	for _, lead := range leads {
		if !lead.StatusChangedAt.Before(cutoff) {
			continue
		}
		key := "followup-overdue:" + string(lead.ID) + ":" + businessDate.Format("2006-01-02")
		eligible = append(eligible, lead)
		queries = append(queries, data.NewFollowupReminderReceiptQuery().WhereDedupeKeyEqual(key))
	}
	if len(eligible) == 0 {
		return capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput{}, nil
	}
	existing, err := caps.FollowupReminderReceipt.ExistsBatch(ctx, queries)
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput{}, err
	}
	receipts := make([]schema.CreateFollowupReminderReceipt, 0, len(eligible))
	intents := make([]capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersNotificationIntent, 0, len(eligible))
	for index, lead := range eligible {
		if existing[index] {
			continue
		}
		key := "followup-overdue:" + string(lead.ID) + ":" + businessDate.Format("2006-01-02")
		receipts = append(receipts, schema.CreateFollowupReminderReceipt{
			BusinessDate: businessDate,
			DedupeKey:    key,
			LeadID:       schema.NewFollowupReminderReceiptLeadIDReference(lead.ID),
			RecipientID:  schema.NewFollowupReminderReceiptRecipientIDReference(lead.ResponsibleUserID.ID()),
			SentAt:       now.UTC(),
		})
		companyName := lead.CompanyName
		intents = append(intents, capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersNotificationIntent{
			EventType:        "lead.followup_overdue",
			SourceEventID:    key,
			RecipientUserIDs: []string{string(lead.ResponsibleUserID.ID())},
			SubjectObjectKey: "sales_lead",
			SubjectRecordID:  string(lead.ID),
			SubjectVersion:   lead.UpdatedAt,
			DedupeKey:        key,
			GroupKey:         "lead-followup:" + string(lead.ID),
			Alert:            true,
			OccurredAt:       now.UTC(),
			Variables: []capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersNotificationVariable{
				{Key: "company_name", StringValue: &companyName},
			},
		})
	}
	if len(receipts) == 0 {
		return capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput{}, nil
	}
	created, err := caps.FollowupReminderReceipt.CreateBatch(ctx, receipts)
	if err != nil {
		return capabilities.SendOverdueRemindersOutput{}, err

	if len(created) != len(receipts) {

	notificationIDs, err := caps.Notifications.DispatchBatch(ctx, intents)

	}

# M1 Benchmark:销售线索 CRM 需求规格

本文档是 benchmark 的唯一需求输入。评分对照 golden-checklist(agent 不可见)。

## 业务背景

一家 B2B 公司的销售团队管理线索(lead)到成交客户(customer)的全流程:销售录入并跟进线索,大额转化需销售总监审批,团队按部门划分数据边界,管理层看漏斗报表并导出。

## 组织与角色

- 销售分属**部门**(至少两个部门:华东区、华北区),存在汇报线。
- **sales_rep(销售)**:录入/跟进自己名下的线索;可见范围=本部门线索;发起转化。
- **sales_director(销售总监)**:全部门可见;审批大额转化;查看/导出漏斗报表。

## 功能需求

### 线索管理
1. 线索字段:公司名(必填)、联系人、联系电话、预计金额(精确金额,两位小数)、来源(select:官网/展会/转介绍/外呼)、状态、负责人(销售)、部门、创建/更新时间。
2. 线索状态机:`new → contacted → qualified → converted / lost`;`qualified` 可标记 `lost`;`converted`、`lost` 为终态,不可再转换。
3. 销售创建线索(初始 new,负责人=本人,部门=本人部门);可更新自己名下线索的联系人/电话/预计金额/来源。
4. 跟进(contacted)与合格判定(qualified)由负责人执行;状态只能沿定义的转换变化。
5. 线索创建幂等(相同幂等键重复提交只建一条)。

### 转化与审批(核心业务)
6. 负责人对 `qualified` 线索发起**转化**:预计金额 < 100000 时直接转化;≥ 100000 时必须进入**审批流**,由 sales_director 审批。
7. 审批通过:线索进入 `converted`,并在**同一事务**中创建 `customer` 客户记录(承接公司名/联系人/金额/来源线索引用);审批拒绝:线索回到 `qualified` 并记录拒绝原因。
8. 转化必须幂等:同一线索重复发起转化不产生第二个客户。
9. 审批结果(通过/拒绝)以站内通知发给发起的销售。
10. 客户记录只读(任何角色不可更新/删除客户;修正走新流程,本期不做)。

### 数据边界
11. 销售的线索可见范围 = **本部门**(同部门同事的线索可见,跨部门不可见);更新/状态操作仅限**自己名下**。
12. 总监全量可见。
13. 所有状态变化与转化审批留审计。

### 跟进提醒(定时)
14. 每天早上(工作日)由**定时任务**扫描:`contacted` 状态超过 7 天未变化的线索,给负责人发站内提醒(每条线索每天最多提醒一次)。

### 报表与导出
15. 总监可见**漏斗报表**:按状态统计线索数与预计金额合计;销售无权查看。
16. 总监可**导出线索明细 CSV**(带当前权限过滤);导出必须走受控导出通道(有界、审计、requester 专属)。
17. 线索列表服务端有界分页。

### 导航与验收
18. 两角色登录 Business Workspace 后菜单与权限一致(销售:我的线索;总监:全部线索、报表)。
19. 提供两个部门 × 各 1 名销售 + 1 名总监的非人类验收身份,以及覆盖所有状态、两个部门、含 ≥100000 与 <100000 金额的种子线索(≥6 条),保证每条需求可在真实 Runtime 验证。

## 范围限定

仅 Business Workspace;无 Consumer Portal、无外部连接器;金额计算只做求和,不涉及分成/结算。

## 公开业务旅程追踪 ID

以下 ID 是需求输入的一部分，不包含 evaluator 的隐藏断言。`docs/backend-requirements-prd.md`
必须建立需求 → flow ID → 测试名/路径追踪；`backend/tests/businessflow/` 下对应的顶层 Go 测试名
必须以 `TestBFxx` 开头。同一 ID 可以拆成多个测试，但每个分支都要验证持久化终态和失败后的状态不变性。

- `BF01`：销售创建线索、创建幂等、本人更新、负责人状态推进，以及同部门非负责人写入拒绝。
- `BF02`：小额线索从 qualified 直接转化、只创建一个只读客户，并验证重放幂等。
- `BF03`：大额线索发起审批并由总监通过；线索转化与客户创建同事务，发起人收到通知。
- `BF04`：大额审批拒绝；线索回到 qualified、拒绝原因与通知可读，且不创建客户。
- `BF05`：两个部门销售的同部门可见/跨部门不可见、总监全量可见、有界分页和角色菜单差异。
- `BF06`：工作日逾期跟进提醒，包含单日去重及重启后结果保持。
- `BF07`：总监漏斗报表的状态计数与金额合计正确，销售访问被拒绝。

# Permissions and data scope

Code-owned resources define the stable permission catalog. The backend model
defines application roles and business scope decisions. Identity owns users,
credentials, live assignments and principal resolution.

## Compact role input

Roles are keyed by stable identity. Each exact Permission grant carries its own
data visibility decision:

```json
{"roles": {
  "work_operator": [
    "work_item.read;owner",
    "work_item.export;org",
    "work_item_attachment.read;org_child;audit_denial"
  ]
}}
```

When a Role also needs metadata, use the extended object form and put the same
grant strings under `grants`:

```json
{"roles": {
  "work_operator": {
    "grants": [
      "work_item.read;owner",
      "work_item.export;org",
      "work_item_attachment.read;org_child;audit_denial"
    ],
    "field_permissions": {
      "work_item.private_note": {
        "read": true,
        "write": false,
        "export": false,
        "masked": true,
        "reason": "Private notes are not exportable"
      }
    }
  }
}}
```

`name` defaults from the role key. Every array item is an exact Permission key
and one of `all`, `owner`, `org`, `org_child`, or `target_org`, separated by a
semicolon. Append `;audit_denial` only when denied attempts must be audited.
Duplicate Permission keys are invalid. `grants` may be omitted from the extended
object when no explicit business grant exists.

The backend model must not declare role-level `data_scope`, `scope_overrides`,
`record_scope`, `data_permissions`,
`reference_permissions`, a root `permissions` collection, accounts, sessions,
users, assignments, or menu assignments.

## Compiler authorization closure

Plane preserves each authored scoped grant and validates the complete
authorization closure:

- `Action` -> the same-key Permission definition registered by Runtime;
- Role same-key Action grants -> the compiler-derived Action allowlist;
- explicit Object read/export/CRUD grants -> their own scoped grants;
- eligible relation fields -> exact source/field/target reference policies;
- Report and Export Control sources -> their validated functional/data closure.

The compiled Blueprint and Runtime Manifest contain only
`permissions[].permission_key/data_scope/audit_denial` for Role authorization.

A Handler-written Object is `action_only`. Its allowed roles explicitly grant
the same-key Action Permission, but do not receive direct CRUD mutation
permissions. Authoring such a direct permission is a blocking write-owner
conflict.

Field, export and guardrail policies remain explicit business exceptions and
use keyed maps wherever their schema has stable identity. Reference policies
are compiler-owned because relation target and role access are already known.
Custom data predicates are not part of role authoring. If none of the five
canonical scopes expresses the requirement, stop and surface a contract gap;
do not invent a sixth value or embed a predicate:

```json
{"roles": {"work_operator": ["work_item.read;owner"]}}
```

## Runtime ownership and verification

At apply, Plane publishes the generated project role catalog. Identity stores
current users and role assignments. Runtime evaluates the resolved principal,
exact scoped grant, field/reference policy and export policy on every
request.

Scope enforcement is storage-bound. For `all`, SQL keeps workspace, caller
filters and target IDs but adds no data-scope predicate. For the other four
values, list/read SQL combines the compiled scope predicate with caller filters;
update/delete/restore first select the requested single ID or bounded ID batch
within that scope, then retain the same predicate on the atomic mutation. Mixed
allowed/out-of-scope batches fail and roll back.
Application-side filtering of unscoped rows is never sufficient evidence.

Verification uses SDK-backed principals created through the supported Identity
test path:

- positive cases prove the exact Permission grant and matching `data_scope`;
- function-denied cases omit the permission or assignment;
- row-denied cases target a record outside the selected scope;
- rejected mutations prove durable state did not change;
- field/reference/export cases assert their exact masking or denial.

Never paste an SDK `AccessBundle`, `FunctionGrant`, or `DataPolicy` into
`backend/model/*.json`, and never provision a Blueprint user just to make a
test executable.
# Business entrypoint metadata

Entrypoints describe named business journeys for requirement coverage. They do
not define product shells, pages, routes, components, login modes, or
authorization. Runtime permissions remain attached to roles, operations, and
data scopes.

```json
{
  "entrypoints": {
    "sales_pipeline": {
      "audience": "sales_team",
      "primary_object": "opportunity",
      "read_objects": ["account", "contact", "opportunity"],
      "create_objects": ["account", "contact", "opportunity"],
      "update_objects": ["account", "contact", "opportunity"]
    },
    "customer_onboarding": {
      "audience": "customer_success",
      "primary_object": "account",
      "read_objects": ["account", "contact"],
      "update_objects": ["account", "contact"]
    }
  }
}
```

Entrypoint identity is the map key and the display name defaults from it.
Object lists are journey reachability metadata, not grants. Never invent an
entrypoint permission or use entrypoint metadata to authorize an operation.
Frontend source owns layout, navigation, routes, and login presentation.
```

Identity then returns organization nodes whose IDs are in that administrator's
support subtree, returns users whose `org_id` is in the same subtree, and
rejects creation of a user whose `org_id` falls outside it. Add update, disable,
role-assignment, credential or security Actions only when the requirements call
for them; list/create scope never implies those grants.

The current user model has one `support_org_id`, so it expresses one connected
organization subtree. If one actor must serve several unrelated roots, do not
silently use `all` or invent a list-valued field: use a truthful common parent
node when the organization model has one, otherwise surface a contract gap.

There is no `none` or `custom` scope. Absence of an exact Permission grant means deny.
This example scopes member records to Runtime-maintained ownership:

```json
{
  "objects": {
    "gym_member": {
      "fields": {
        "identity_user_id": "relation!->identity_user;unique",
        "status": "select![active:有效|frozen:冻结]=active"
      }
    },
    "booking": {"fields": {"member_id": "relation!->gym_member"}}
  },
  "roles": {
    "member": ["gym_member.read;owner", "booking.read;owner", "booking.create;owner"],
    "front_desk": ["gym_member.read;all", "booking.read;all", "booking.update;all"]
  },
  "entrypoints": {
    "member_booking": {
	  "audience": "consumer",
      "primary_object": "booking",
      "read_objects": ["gym_member", "booking"],
      "create_objects": ["booking"]
    },
    "front_desk": {
	  "audience": "internal",
      "primary_object": "booking",
      "read_objects": ["gym_member", "booking"],
      "update_objects": ["booking"]
    }
  }
}
```

Plane preserves every exact scoped grant. Runtime exposes an entrypoint only
when the exact Permission and its row scope pass. Tests provision real Identity principals and prove positive,
function-denied and out-of-scope cases, including unchanged durable state after
rejected writes.

Never author Identity users, assignments, SDK access bundles, ownership system
columns, wildcard permissions or an application-side authorization service.

## apply

Read [project mutation](references/project-mutation.md), then apply the reviewed model:

```sh
"$DOMAINRY_CLI" apply model --json --project "$PROJECT_ROOT" \
  --go-module-path <domain-qualified-module>

Retain its immutable implementation packet. Read [ownership and extensions](references/ownership-and-extensions.md), then implement only the project-owned backend source and paired tests declared by that packet. For a selected custom Connector, request its focused context with `model capability --connector-context <connector.provider>` immediately before implementation. The only frontend mutation exception is a Data Exchange offline-export center for an exportable Object SQL Report when `Frontend mutation scope: integration_authorized`; follow [its contract](references/frontend-offline-report-export.md). Otherwise report the owner gap.

Run focused tests, then finalize every delivered Handler and Connector:

```sh
"$DOMAINRY_CLI" apply finalize --json --project "$PROJECT_ROOT"
```

## Empty values and commands

Omit empty strings, arrays and objects. Omit absent `input`, `output`,
`permissions`, `config`, `preconditions` and optional collections; Plane
creates required empty internal structures. `false` and `0` remain legal only
when they are deliberate business values.

```

`model plan` is the no-HTTP repair loop. It runs the same loader, Ledger graph,
authoring checks, Project Contract projection, Runtime Manifest compiler and
source-owner validators used by apply. `apply model` atomically converges the
generated Ledger; an item absent from the model is a destructive deletion and
requires `--allow-destructive`.

Capability assembly remains progressive: choose from bounded summaries, load
only selected focused definitions, and let Plane compile ownership, module
closure and digests. Never author or cache a capability assembly in the model.

package recordmodel

type Record struct {
	WorkspaceID  string                        `json:"workspace_id"`
	ID           string                        `json:"id"`
	Data         map[string]any                `json:"data"`
	CreatedAt    string                        `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt    string                        `json:"updated_at"`
	Deleted      bool                          `json:"deleted"`
	ExtInfo      map[string]any                `json:"ext_info,omitempty"`
	CreateBy     string                        `json:"create_by,omitempty"`
	UpdateBy     string                        `json:"update_by,omitempty"`
	OwnerUserID  string                        `json:"owner_user_id,omitempty"`
	OwnerOrgID   string                        `json:"owner_org_id,omitempty"`
	Localization *RecordLocalizationResolution `json:"localization,omitempty"`
}

// RecordLocalizedValue is one translated business-record field. Stable facts
// such as SKU, price and inventory remain on the owning Record.
type RecordLocalizedValue struct {
	RecordID  string `json:"record_id"`
	FieldKey  string `json:"field_key"`
	Locale    string `json:"locale"`
	TextValue string `json:"text_value"`
}

// RecordLocalizedValueMutation is persisted in the same transaction as its
// owning Record mutation. An empty TextValue removes that locale override.
type RecordLocalizedValueMutation struct {
	FieldKey  string `json:"field_key"`
	Locale    string `json:"locale"`
	TextValue string `json:"text_value"`
}

type RecordLocalizationResolution struct {
	RequestedLocale string            `json:"requested_locale"`
	FallbackLocale  string            `json:"fallback_locale,omitempty"`
	FieldSources    map[string]string `json:"field_sources,omitempty"`
}

type RecordSortRule struct {
	Field     string `json:"field"`
	Direction string `json:"direction"`
}

// RecordScopeExpression is the storage-neutral authorization predicate produced
// from a role data-scope filter. Relation segments are resolved against the
// installed object graph before the query reaches persistence.
type RecordScopeExpression struct {
	Operator string                   `json:"operator"`
	FieldKey string                   `json:"field_key,omitempty"`
	Path     []RecordScopePathSegment `json:"path,omitempty"`
	Values   []string                 `json:"values,omitempty"`
	Children []RecordScopeExpression  `json:"children,omitempty"`
	// RelationExists is set only by Repository scope resolution when the
	// resolved permission ID set exceeds the published IN threshold.
	RelationExists bool `json:"-"`
}

type RecordScopePathSegment struct {
	SourceObjectKey  string `json:"source_object_key"`
	Direction        string `json:"direction"`
	RelationFieldKey string `json:"relation_field_key"`
	TargetObjectKey  string `json:"target_object_key"`
}

type RecordQueryAuthorizationMode string

const (
	RecordQueryAuthorizationUnrestricted RecordQueryAuthorizationMode = "unrestricted"
	RecordQueryAuthorizationPredicate    RecordQueryAuthorizationMode = "predicate"
	RecordQueryAuthorizationDeny         RecordQueryAuthorizationMode = "deny"
)

type RecordAuthorizationDiagnostic struct {
	Code      string                       `json:"code"`
	ObjectKey string                       `json:"object_key"`
	Mode      RecordQueryAuthorizationMode `json:"mode"`
	Path      string                       `json:"path,omitempty"`
	Detail    string                       `json:"detail,omitempty"`
}

type RecordListQuery struct {
	Page                    int                            `json:"page"`
	PageSize                int                            `json:"page_size"`
	Search                  string                         `json:"search,omitempty"`
	SearchFields            []string                       `json:"search_fields,omitempty"`
	Filters                 map[string]any                 `json:"filters,omitempty"`
	FilterExpression        *RecordFilterExpression        `json:"filter,omitempty"`
	Sort                    []RecordSortRule               `json:"sort,omitempty"`
	SelectFields            []string                       `json:"select_fields,omitempty"`
	LockIntent              string                         `json:"lock_intent,omitempty"`
	AuthorizationMode       RecordQueryAuthorizationMode   `json:"-"`
	ScopeExpression         *RecordScopeExpression         `json:"-"`
	AuthorizationDiagnostic *RecordAuthorizationDiagnostic `json:"-"`
	RootObjectKey           string                         `json:"-"`
	Locale                  string                         `json:"-"`
	FallbackLocale          string                         `json:"-"`
	SkipTotal               bool                           `json:"-"`
	AfterID                 string                         `json:"-"`
}

type RecordPageResult struct {
	Items    []Record `json:"items"`
	Page     int      `json:"page"`
	PageSize int      `json:"page_size"`
	Total    int      `json:"total"`
	HasNext  bool     `json:"has_next"`
}

	Data           map[string]any `json:"data,omitempty"`

	ObjectKey string `json:"object_key"`
	RecordID  string `json:"record_id"`
